devAccessEstimate: Same day, but for Sign In with LinkedIn and basic profile only
productionEstimate: 2-8 weeks reported by developers for partner-program products (Marketing, Community Management, Sales Navigator, Talent). LinkedIn does not publish acceptance criteria or a guaranteed timeline.

steps.action: Create a LinkedIn developer app in the Developer Portal, associated with a LinkedIn Company Page you administer
Sign In with LinkedIn and basic Share APIs are available immediately with no partner approval needed

Anything beyond that (Marketing Developer Platform, Community Management API, Sales Navigator, Talent Solutions) requires applying to the matching partner program under the app's Products tab, with a specific use-case justification
Expect a vetting and identity-review step as part of partner-program applications. Denials can be appealed through LinkedIn's contact form

blockers.description: LinkedIn does not provide public access to its APIs beyond basic sign-in. All further access requires joining the LinkedIn Partner Program, individual developers cannot simply register an app and start calling the API
Approval criteria and acceptance rates for partner programs are not publicly documented beyond the listed process steps

escalationPath: LinkedIn's Contact form for vetting appeals. No published support SLA for partner-program applications, treat the 2-8 week range as unofficial.
